paite: Huai lai in Israel gam ah kumpipa a-om kei. Dan chite’n gam luah ding azong uhi. Israel chite lak ah gam luah ding atang nai kei uhi.
heading: Mikah Leh Dan Nam
english: In those days there was no king in Israel. In those days the tribe of the Danites sought an inheritance to dwell in; for to that day, their inheritance had not fallen to them among the tribes of Israel.

paite: Dan suante'n anam pumpi lak ua mi, pasalpha nga, Zorah leh Eshtaol a pan gam enkhe ding leh va entel ding in mi asawl uhi. Akiang uah, "Va kuan unla, gam va entel dih ua," achi uhi. Huchi in Ephraim tanggam a Mikah inn ava tung ua, huai ah agiak uhi.
english: The children of Dan sent five men of their family from their whole number, men of valor, from Zorah and from Eshtaol, to spy out the land and to search it. They said to them, “Go, explore the land!” They came to the hill country of Ephraim, to the house of Micah, and lodged there.

paite: Mikah inn kiang a a-om lai un, Levi chi tangval aw athei ua, huai lam ava zuan ua, akiang ah, "Hiai a hon pi kua ahia? Hiai mun ah bang ahia na hih? Bangchi in ahia hiai a na ten?" achi uhi.
english: When they were by the house of Micah, they knew the voice of the young man the Levite; so they went over there and said to him, “Who brought you here? What do you do in this place? What do you have here?”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Mikah in huchi in ahon na bawlta a, ahon guai a, asiampu in ka om hi," achi hi.
english: He said to them, “Thus and thus has Micah dealt with me, and he has hired me, and I have become his priest.”

paite: Amau akiang ah, "Ka hohna ding uah ka lamzang ding uh hia ding lou, chih theihtheihna ding in Pathian hon dotsak dih ve," achi uhi.
english: They said to him, “Please ask counsel of God, that we may know whether our way which we go shall be prosperous.”

paite: Siampu in akiang uah, "Lungmuangtak in pai un. Na hohna ding ma uah TOUPA a-om hi,” achi hi.
english: The priest said to them, “Go in peace. Your way in which you go is before Yahweh.”

paite: Huchi in mi ngate apawtkhia ua, Laish ah alut ua, huai mite Zidon mite mah bang a galmuangtak leh lungmuangtak a om hithiat a om ava mu ua; amaute zahlaksak ding thuneimi kuamah a-om kei a, Zidonte toh akigamla ua, kuamah toh leng akisai kha kei uhi.
english: Then the five men departed and came to Laish and saw the people who were there, how they lived in safety, in the way of the Sidonians, quiet and secure; for there was no one in the land possessing authority, that might put them to shame in anything, and they were far from the Sidonians, and had no dealings with anyone else.

paite: Zorah leh Eshtaol ah a-unaute uh kiang ah ahong pai ua; a-unaute un akiang uah, "Bangchi ahia oi?" achi uhi.
english: They came to their brothers at Zorah and Eshtaol; and their brothers asked them, “What do you say?”

paite: Amau, "Thou dih ua, i sual ding uh. Gam ahihleh ka va mu ngei ua, ngai un, ahoih mahmah hi. Dai maimah ding na hi uhia? Huai gam va lut a, va luah ding in zekai kei dih uh.
english: They said, “Arise, and let’s go up against them; for we have seen the land, and behold, it is very good. Do you stand still? Don’t be slothful to go and to enter in to possess the land.

paite: Va hoh le uchin galmuang a om mite ahi chih na va mu ding uh; agam lah aza mahmah ngal a. Pathian in nou ahon pe khinta hi. Lei a thil om ah zaw bangmah taksap ding a-om hetlouhna mun ahi," achi uhi.
english: When you go, you will come to an unsuspecting people, and the land is large; for God has given it into your hand, a place where there is no lack of anything that is on the earth.”

paite: Huchi in Zorah leh Eshtaol a pan Dan namte kidouna galthuam silh in mi zaguk apawt uhi.
english: The family of the Danites set out from Zorah and Eshtaol with six hundred men armed with weapons of war.

paite: Ava hohtou ua, Judah gam Kiriath-jearim ah om mun abawl uh. Huaiziak in huai mun tuni tan in Mananeh Dan achi lai ua, Kiriath-jearim tang lam a om ahi.
english: They went up and encamped in Kiriath Jearim in Judah. Therefore they call that place Mahaneh Dan to this day. Behold, it is behind Kiriath Jearim.

paite: Huai a pan Ephraim tanggam lam azuan ua, Mikah inn ava tung uhi.
english: They passed from there to the hill country of Ephraim, and came to the house of Micah.

paite: Huchi in Laish gam enkhe dia mi nga pawtte'n adawng ua, a-unaute uh kiang ah, "Hiai innte ah ephod, milimte, milim bawltawmte, milim suntawmte a-om chih na thei uhia? Huchi bangchi in ahia na hih ding uh ngaihtuah un," achi uhi,
english: Then the five men who went to spy out the country of Laish answered and said to their brothers, “Do you know that there is in these houses an ephod, and teraphim, and a carved image, and a molten image? Now therefore consider what you have to do.”

paite: Huai a pan apai ua, Levi chi tangval omna Mikah inn ngei ava tung ua, atungtang thu adong uhi.
english: They went over there and came to the house of the young Levite man, even to the house of Micah, and asked him how he was doing.

paite: Dan suan mi zaguk kidouna galthuam silhte kulh kongpi bul ah adingh uhi.
english: The six hundred men armed with their weapons of war, who were of the children of Dan, stood by the entrance of the gate.

paite: Mi nga gam enkhete ava hohtou ua, alut ua, milim bawltawm, ephod, milimte leh suntawm milimte ala ua, mi zaguk kidouna galthuam silhte lak ah kulh kongpi bul ah siampu adingh hi.
english: The five men who went to spy out the land went up, and came in there, and took the engraved image, the ephod, the teraphim, and the molten image; and the priest stood by the entrance of the gate with the six hundred men armed with weapons of war.

paite: Huaite Mikah inn ah ava lut ua, bawltawm milimte, ephod, milimte leh suntawm milimte ava lak uleh, siampu in akiang uah, "Hiai a bang hih na mai ua?" achi hi.
english: When these went into Micah’s house, and took the engraved image, the ephod, the teraphim, and the molten image, the priest said to them, “What are you doing?”

paite: Amau, "Dai in, na khut in na muk hum inla, ka kiang uah hong pai inla, ka pa uh leh siampu ding un hong om in. Nang a ding in inn khat kia siampu a om hia hoihzaw, Israel lak a chi khat leh nam khat siampu dia om?" achi uhi.
english: They said to him, “Hold your peace, put your hand on your mouth, and go with us. Be a father and a priest to us. Is it better for you to be priest to the house of one man, or to be priest to a tribe and a family in Israel?”

paite: Siampu lungtang akipak mahmah a, huchi in ephod, milim leh bawltawm milimte ala a, mipite lak ah a-omta hi.
english: The priest’s heart was glad, and he took the ephod, the teraphim, and the engraved image, and went with the people.

paite: Huchi in apaikhia ua, anau neute uh, gante uh leh avante uh amasuan tou zel uh.
english: So they turned and departed, and put the little ones, the livestock, and the goods before them.

paite: Mikah inn a pan gamla kuam apaikhiak nung un Mikah invengte akikaikhawm ua, Dan suante adelhphata uhi.
english: When they were a good way from the house of Micah, the men who were in the houses near Micah’s house gathered together and overtook the children of Dan.

paite: Dan suante asam uhi. Amau anunglam anga ua, Mikah kiang ah, "Bang achia ahia, mi huai zahzah na hon tonpih?" achi uhi.
english: As they called to the children of Dan, they turned their faces, and said to Micah, “What ails you, that you come with such a company?”

paite: Ama'n, "Ka bawl pathiante leh siampu na paipih ua, na pai vengveng ua, bang ka nei lai a? Bangziak a bangchi na hia, na hon chih uh?" achi hi.
english: He said, “You have taken away my gods which I made, and the priest, and have gone away! What more do I have? How can you ask me, ‘What ails you?’”

paite: Dan suante'n akiang ah, "Ka lak uah pau mawkmawk kei dih aw, huchi lou in zaw mithangpai khut na thuak kha dia, na inkote toh na hinna na tan ding uh," achi uhi.
english: The children of Dan said to him, “Don’t let your voice be heard among us, lest angry fellows fall on you, and you lose your life, with the lives of your household.”

paite: Huchi in Dan suante apai ua, Mikah in lah sual ngam vual hi un athei kei a, a-inn lam ah apai nawnta hi.
english: The children of Dan went their way; and when Micah saw that they were too strong for him, he turned and went back to his house.

paite: Mikah thilbawlte leh asiampu neih apaipih ua, Laish khua, galmuang a om hithiatte kiang atungtou ua, namsau in athat ua; mei in khua ahalta uh.
english: They took that which Micah had made, and the priest whom he had, and came to Laish, to a people quiet and unsuspecting, and struck them with the edge of the sword; then they burned the city with fire.

paite: Zidon a pan agamlat mahmah ziak in va hunkhe ding mi kuamah a-om kei, akuakua toh kizatna mahmah anei kei uh. Beth-rehob kiang a om phaizang ahi a, khopi khat alam ua, huai ah atengta uhi.
english: There was no deliverer, because it was far from Sidon, and they had no dealings with anyone else; and it was in the valley that lies by Beth Rehob. They built the city and lived in it.

paite: Akho min Israel tapa, apu uh Dan tam in, Dan asa uhi. Himahleh atung in huai kho min Laish ahi.
english: They called the name of the city Dan, after the name of Dan their father, who was born to Israel; however the name of the city used to be Laish.

paite: Dan suante'n huai milim bawltawm adingkhesakta ua, Mosi tapa Gershon tapa Jonathan leh atapate, gam sal a pi ahih masiah uh Dan chite siampu ahita uhi.
english: The children of Dan set up for themselves the engraved image; and Jonathan, the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, and his sons were priests to the tribe of the Danites until the day of the captivity of the land.

paite: Huchi in Mikah bawltawm milim ahihleh Shiloh a Pathian inn a a-om lai teng adingsak uhi.
english: So they set up for themselves Micah’s engraved image which he made, and it remained all the time that God’s house was in Shiloh.
